claims.claim: SGLang accepts one request-level constraint among JSON Schema, regex and EBNF, and documents XGrammar, Outlines and Llguidance as grammar backends with different feature support.

claims.claim: XGrammar constructs TokenizerInfo and GrammarCompiler, keeps a cache budget, and creates a separate uncached framing compiler for structural tags.
XGrammarGrammar exposes matcher-based next-token bitmask generation, device movement and logits masking; accepted tokens advance matcher state and rollback restores prior matcher state.

claims.claim: GrammarManager routes schema/regex/EBNF/structural-tag requests through grammar keys and a grammar queue; ready and failed request decisions are synchronized across DP/TP and PP ranks.
XGrammar prechecks context-independent vocabulary tokens, uses persistent stack structures for context-dependent checks and overlaps grammar work with GPU execution.
claims.locator: XGrammar paper abstract and core design

claims.claim: Structured output constraints guarantee conformance to the selected grammar, not semantic truth or business authorization.
